Assistant manager

What needs doing this week: contracts, offers, unhappy players, injuries, form, youth and gaps in the squad.

Inbox

Player messages, expiring contracts, requests and club events. This is where you talk to your players.

Sell players

Clubs send offers for your players. Listed players attract more offers. Accept or negotiate (up to 3 rounds).

Player requests

Unhappy players ask to leave. List them, promise minutes (if still benched they return angrier) or refuse.

Transfer list

All players on lists: from the game (save/Sider), AI clubs in the app (realistic logic: surplus, older, wants to leave) and your list. Sorted by OVR.

Click a player for attributes. The AI-club list in the app is generated once per window (summer/winter) and drops players who change club.

AI transfers

The app proposes moves between AI clubs. Nothing is written until you press “Apply”.

Automatic AI transfers

When you save and go to the main menu (and confirm it in the app) or close the game, the app writes the transfers that have become due by the date in the save (spread over the summer and winter windows, heaviest on deadline day). Runs in the background while the app is open.

AI managers (tactics)

Every AI club gets a lasting playing style (possession, counter, high press, wings, low block…) and its manager adapts it to the form of the last 5 matches. The game itself never changes tactics. Changes are logged in News. Your club is left alone.

History
